fact: General Notice No. 79 of 2025, under the Standards and Quality Act, 2023 (Act No. 16 of 2023), designated 19 new Eswatini National Standards, including the National Addressing Standard Part 1 (SZNS ISO 19160-1:2015) and Part 2 (SZNS ISO 19160-2:2022) on address classes and assigning and maintaining addresses; the article names no standards body and gives the publication date as the date.

The Standards and Quality Act (Act 10 of 2003), assented to on 8 November 2001 with commencement to be proclaimed by the Minister, establishes the Eswatini Standards Authority as a body corporate with power to draft, issue, amend and withdraw Eswatini standards.
